item.title: Object pools
item.description: In garbage-collected languages, object pools provide a way to eliminate runtime memory allocation and garbage collection for critical code paths.

item.title: Zero GC Java
item.description: These are just a few notes on how to write Java without garbage collection or runtime memory allocation.

item.title: Herbicide
item.description: The common herbicides used on Kentucky bluegrass lawns in the US are 2,4D Dicamba MCPP Quinclorac Mesotrione (Tenacity) It’s hard for me to find dicamba and quinclorac in Japan.

item.title: Mowing the lawn
item.description: Kentucky bluegrass will grow about 1-2 inches (25-51 mm) per week in its peak season.
